lead: Exploring the evolving landscape of education, from innovative kids' apps to advanced AI management courses for IT leaders.

stories.title: This educational kids app gives parents a much-needed break — and now it’s $60 for life
stories.summary: Pok Pok, an educational app for children, is now available for a lifetime subscription at a one-time cost of $60. This app not only entertains kids but also provides educational content, allowing parents to take a much-needed break. With its engaging approach to learning, Pok Pok aims to make education enjoyable for young learners.

stories.title: 10 courses for IT leaders navigating AI change management
stories.summary: As AI continues to reshape business operations, IT leaders are increasingly required to manage organizational change effectively. This article highlights ten educational courses designed to equip leaders with the skills necessary for navigating AI change management. From online programs at Harvard Business School to in-person courses at MIT, these offerings cover a range of topics essential for leading in an AI-driven environment.

stories.title: Why the US is at risk of losing the AI talent and productivity war
stories.summary: The U.S. faces a significant challenge in maintaining its leadership in AI due to a shortage of STEM graduates and skilled professionals. This article discusses the implications of this gap on AI leadership and productivity, emphasizing the need for a robust educational framework to prepare future talent. It also highlights successful models from other countries that could inform U.S. strategies to enhance its STEM pipeline.

stories.title: AI Change Management: Cultivating a Continuous Learning Culture
stories.summary: Skillsoft's program on AI Change Management focuses on fostering a continuous learning culture within organizations. It emphasizes innovative learning strategies to help employees adapt to AI technologies. By engaging in microlearning and gamified experiences, participants will learn how to empower their teams to embrace AI and measure the success of these initiatives.

stories.title: Navigating Transitions During AI-Driven Change
stories.summary: MIT's course on Navigating Transitions During AI-Driven Change is crafted for leaders looking to understand the organizational impacts of AI. Participants will learn how to implement AI effectively and build resilience within their teams. The program offers both in-person and online formats, making it accessible to a wide range of professionals.

stories.title: AI strategies for Business Transformation
stories.summary: Northwestern's Kellogg School of Management offers an AI strategies program aimed at business leaders. This eight-week online course focuses on applying AI to enhance customer experience and productivity. Participants will engage in discussions and projects that aim to unlock business value through strategic AI implementation.

stories.title: AI-Driven Leadership: Strategies for the Future
stories.summary: Stanford's six-week online course on AI-Driven Leadership prepares mid-level and senior executives to leverage AI technologies effectively. The curriculum covers decision-making processes and operational efficiency improvements through AI. This program is designed for leaders looking to understand the strategic implications of AI in their organizations.

stories.title: Strategic Leadership in the Age of Generative and Agentic AI
stories.summary: The University of Chicago offers a comprehensive online certificate program that spans eight months, focusing on strategic leadership in the context of generative AI. Participants will learn to build AI literacy and governance frameworks, culminating in hands-on projects that apply their learning to real-world scenarios. This program aims to equip leaders with the skills necessary for navigating the complexities of AI.
